```text
cat_go() {
  # macOS installs go_tools binaries via Homebrew (translate + dev →
  # daviddwlee84/tap), so `go install` is Linux-only — skip on macOS to avoid
  # re-creating ~/.local/bin copies that shadow brew. Mirrors the go_tools role
  # gate; on macOS upgrade via `brew upgrade` (just upgrade-brew).
  if [[ "$(uname -s)" == "Darwin" ]]; then
    warn "go tools are Homebrew-managed on macOS — skipping (use \`brew upgrade\`)"
    return $SKIP_RC
  fi

  # Resolve go via mise shim first, then system PATH.
  local go_cmd=""
  if [[ -x "$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims/go" ]]; then
    go_cmd="$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims/go"
  elif command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    go_cmd="go"
  else
    warn "go not found (Go not installed via mise?) — skipping"
    return $SKIP_RC
  fi

  # Parse the tools list from defaults YAML — lines `  - name: <pkg>@<ver>`.
  # Same hand-rolled awk parser as cat_dotnet.
  local defaults_file="$_REPO_ROOT/dot_ansible/roles/go_tools/defaults/main.yml"
  local tools=()
  if [[ -f "$defaults_file" ]]; then
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      tools+=("$line")
    done < <(awk '
            /^go_tools:/ { in_list=1; next }
            in_list && /^[^ ]/ { in_list=0 }
            in_list && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*name:/ {
                sub(/^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*name:[[:space:]]*/, "")
                gsub(/["'"'"']/, "")
                print
            }
        ' "$defaults_file")
  fi

  if [[ ${#tools[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    warn "no go tools to upgrade — skipping"
    return $SKIP_RC
  fi

  # Install into ~/.local/bin (the blessed dir), not ~/go/bin or the mise
  # toolchain dir. Upgrade = re-install at @latest regardless of the version
  # pinned in defaults (install-vs-upgrade split — defaults pin for fresh
  # installs, this moves them forward). See docs/this_repo/tool-managers.md.
  # GOPATH pinned to ~/.local/share/go (XDG data) so the build-time module cache
  # doesn't repopulate ~/go — mirrors dot_config/shell/02_legacy_tools.sh and the
  # go_tools ansible role.
  export GOBIN="$HOME/.local/bin"
  export GOPATH="$HOME/.local/share/go"

  local any_fail=0
  for t in "${tools[@]}"; do
    # Strip any @version pin (module paths never contain '@') and go to @latest.
    local pkg="${t%@*}"
    info "Upgrading go tool: $pkg@latest"
    _run "$go_cmd" install "$pkg@latest" || any_fail=1
  done
  return "$any_fail"
}
```
</details></tool-use>

<tool-use data-tool-type="shell" data-tool-name="Bash"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Bash**</summary>
Inspect go_tools install task

```text
---
# Go CLI tools installation via `go install`.
# The Go toolchain is installed via mise (gated on installExtraRuntimes; see
# dot_config/mise/config.toml.tmpl). This role no-ops cleanly when Go is absent.

# =============================================================================
# Resolve the mise-managed Go bin dir (no-op the whole role if Go is absent)
# =============================================================================
# `mise which go` prints the absolute path to the managed go binary
# (~/.local/share/mise/installs/go/<ver>/bin/go); its dirname is the bin dir we
# prepend to PATH so `go install` runs. Empty/failed → Go isn't installed
# (installExtraRuntimes=false, or mise missing) and the install task below is
# skipped. Mirrors the herdr-plus build idiom in dot_ansible/roles/devtools.
- name: Resolve mise Go bin dir
  ansible.builtin.shell: |
    set -o pipefail
    gobin="$(mise which go 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0
    [ -n "$gobin" ] && dirname "$gobin"
  args:
    executable: /bin/bash
  environment:
    PATH: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:{{ ansible_facts['env']['PATH'] }}"
  register: go_bindir
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

# =============================================================================
# Install Go CLI tools (Linux; macOS uses Homebrew)
# =============================================================================
# GOBIN forces binaries into ~/.local/bin (the blessed dir already on PATH),
# not ~/go/bin (GOPATH/bin) or the version-pinned mise toolchain dir. GOPATH is
# pinned to ~/.local/share/go (XDG data) so the build-time module cache lands
# there instead of recreating ~/go — matches the interactive shell
# (dot_config/shell/02_legacy_tools.sh) and scripts/upgrade_tools.sh cat_go. The
# `creates:` guard makes this install-only + idempotent — version bumps go
# through `just upgrade-go` (scripts/upgrade_tools.sh cat_go), never a re-apply.
#
# macOS is EXCLUDED: these tools install via Homebrew (the personal tap for
# `translate`/`dev`, homebrew-core for `gopls`; see Brewfile.tmpl), so this path
# is Linux-only — otherwise both mechanisms fight over the binaries and
# ~/.local/bin shadows brew. cat_go() has the mirror gate.
- name: Install Go CLI tools via go install (Linux; macOS uses Homebrew)
  when:
    - (go_bindir.stdout | default('') | trim) != ""
    - ansible_facts['os_family'] != 'Darwin'
  ansible.builtin.command: "go install {{ item.name }}"
  args:
    creates: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/{{ item.binary }}"
  loop: "{{ go_tools }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.name }}"
  environment:
    GOBIN: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin"
    GOPATH: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/share/go"
    PATH: "{{ (go_bindir.stdout | trim) }}:{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin:{{ ansible_facts['env']['PATH'] }}"
```
</details></tool-use>

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-08-30 07:28:02Z)**_

`dev` 不是這個 repo 裡的自製 script,它是你另一個獨立的開源專案 `daviddwlee84/dev-cli`(Go 寫的 repository/task/worktree command center)。所以它是用「外部工具」的標準雙通道機制在管,不需要專屬的 `upgrade-dev`。

## 安裝(install-only)

| 平台 | 機制 | 位置 |
|---|---|---|
| macOS | Homebrew tap `daviddwlee84/tap/dev-cli`(永遠裝,不受 `installBrewApps` 控制) | `Brewfile.tmpl` |
| Linux | `go install github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/cmd/dev@v0.1.0`,由 `go_tools` role 跑 | `dot_ansible/roles/go_tools/defaults/main.yml:35` |

Linux 這條有 `creates: ~/.local/bin/dev` guard,所以 `chezmoi apply` 只會裝一次,`@v0.1.0` 這個 pin 只對全新安裝有意義,重跑 apply 不會 bump。

## 升級

沒有 `upgrade-dev` 是刻意的 —— 照 CLAUDE.md 的 hard rule:「Tool already managed by brew/uv/npm/cargo/dotnet/gem/mise → do nothing, generic `upgrade` picks it up.」它被通用 recipe 涵蓋:

- **macOS**:`just upgrade-brew` → `brew upgrade`(含 tap formula)
- **Linux**:`just upgrade-go` → `scripts/upgrade_tools.sh` 的 `cat_go()`。它會 parse `go_tools/defaults/main.yml`,**把 `@v0.1.0` pin 剝掉**,重新 `go install …/cmd/dev@latest`

兩者都被 `just upgrade-all` 帶到。

## 其他相關檔案

- Shell 整合:`dot_config/shell/39_dev.sh`
- Completions:macOS 走 tap formula 產生;Linux 走 `run_after_50_generate_completions.sh.tmpl`
- 文件登記:`docs/this_repo/tool-managers.md`(§ Tool index、§ go_tools catalog、A–Z matrix 第 1060 行)

所以現況是對的,不需要加 `upgrade-dev`。真要加也只是重複 `upgrade-brew` / `upgrade-go` 已經做的事。

本機是 Linux,所以 `just upgrade-go` 就是正確途徑。已跑完:

| 工具 | 之前 | 現在 |
|---|---|---|
| **dev** (dev-cli) | v0.1.0 | **v0.2.1** |
| translate | — | v0.6.0 |
| gopls | — | v0.23.0(binary 顯示 v0.23.0,go.mod 抓 v0.49.0 tools 模組) |

`just upgrade-go` 會把 `go_tools/defaults/main.yml` 裡所有 pin 剝掉重裝 `@latest`,所以是連 `translate` 和 `gopls` 一起更新,不只 `dev`。

一個小提醒:`dev` 有大版本跳動(0.1→0.2),completions 是由 `run_after_50_generate_completions.sh.tmpl` 在 `chezmoi apply` 時依 binary mtime 重生的。若想立刻刷新新版子指令的補全:

```
just completions-refresh
```
